correctness.rationale: Full combinatorial proof: the unsigned incidence matrix B of K_n has full row rank in characteristic three, A=B^T B+I, and BB^T=(n-2)I+J. Exact ranks of successive powers determine every modular Jordan multiplicity in three congruence classes. Lifting each adjacency block to the reversible temporal map yields explicit fixed-nullity exponents, sharp orders, primitive-period support, and Möbius inversion formula; independent modular matrix and direct-update computations were executed and agree. Finite checks supplement the unrestricted argument, not replace it.

value.rationale: Triangular Johnson graphs are canonical line graphs of cliques and form an infinite natural family. Their ordinary eigenvalues do not give the modular Jordan multiplicities; the incidence-resonance mechanism supplies a sharp global time-clock trichotomy and exact counts for all fixed times, primitive periods, and finite extension fields. These are structurally motivated complete dynamical invariants, not isolated computations or routine renaming.
